title: nf-core/rnastructurome pipeline parameters
description: This pipeline analyses chemical-based high-throughput RNA structure probing data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. At minimum it must include `sample`, `fastq_1`, `sample_group`, `condition`, and `replicate` columns, with optional `fastq_2` for paired-end data. `sample_id`, `method`, `principle`, `organism`, `chemical`, `RT_enzyme`, `pH`, `adapter_3p`, `adapter_5p`, and `umi_pattern` can be optionally specified in the samplesheet or as flags.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

fasta.help_text: Provide a transcript-level FASTA for rf-count/rf-norm/rf-fold. If omitted, the pipeline will try to resolve transcript FASTA from `params.genomes[organism]` (`transcript_fasta`, `transcriptome`, or `cdna`).

gtf.description: Path to transcript annotation GTF file.
gtf.help_text: Provide a GTF annotation directly. If omitted, the pipeline will try to resolve GTF from `params.genomes[organism].gtf` or download one from Ensembl.

genomes.description: Optional custom reference map keyed by organism/reference name.

ensembl_base_url.description: Ensembl FTP base URL used when auto-resolving transcript FASTA.

ensembl_release.description: Ensembl release for transcript FASTA auto-resolution (`current`, `latest`, or release number like `114`).

ensembl_species_map.description: Optional map from organism keys to Ensembl species names used for transcript FASTA auto-resolution.

ncbi_accessions_map.description: Internal map from normalized viral organism keys to NCBI accession lists.

sample_metadata_options.title: Sample metadata options
sample_metadata_options.description: Global fallback metadata values used when the corresponding column is missing or empty in the input CSV.

sample_id.description: Fallback sample ID for rows missing `sample_id`.

method.description: Fallback probing method for rows missing `method`.

principle.description: Fallback probing principle for rows missing `principle`.

organism.description: Fallback organism for rows missing `organism`, typically a Latin binomial such as `Homo sapiens`.

chemical.description: Fallback chemical probing reagent for rows missing `chemical` (e.g. `1M7`).

RT_enzyme.description: Fallback reverse transcriptase enzyme for rows missing `RT_enzyme` (e.g. `M-MLV`).

pH.description: Fallback DMS reaction pH for rows missing `pH`.

umi_pattern.description: Fallback UMI pattern for rows missing `umi_pattern`. Supplying a pattern enables umi_tools extract before cutadapt.

fuzzy_untreated_pairing.description: When true (default), a treated group with no exact `sample_group`+`replicate` untreated match falls back to the untreated sample sharing the same sample_group base token (portion before the first `_`) at the same replicate — e.g. `MDA-MB-231_untreated_r1` can serve as control for `MDA-MB-231_MTX_treated_r1`. If a treated group still has no untreated after that, and exactly one untreated control exists anywhere else in the same reference, that single control is reused for it (with a warning) — e.g. one shared untreated backing several treated replicates. Set false to require exact matches; unmatched treated groups then proceed without an untreated control (scoring method 2 or 4).

cutadapt_adapter_5p.description: Global fallback 5' adapter sequence(s), comma-separated. If omitted and no per-sample adapter is provided, the pipeline defaults to AGATCGGAAGAGC.

cutadapt_adapter_3p.description: Global fallback 3' adapter sequence(s), comma-separated. If omitted and no per-sample adapter is provided, the pipeline defaults to AGATCGGAAGAGC.

cutadapt_quality_only.description: If true, skip adapter trimming and apply quality/length trimming only.

cutadapt_5quality.description: Base quality threshold for 5' trimming (used for MaP; RT-stop is forced to 0).

cutadapt_len.description: Minimum read length retained after trimming.

cutadapt_min_align.description: Minimum adapter overlap required for trimming.

transcriptome.description: Align against a transcript-level FASTA using Bowtie (RT-stop) / Bowtie2 (MaP). Default (false) downloads a genome FASTA and aligns with STAR.

count_genome.description: Genome route (STAR) quantification method. Default (false) uses STAR --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM projected onto transcripts, tag-corrected with samtools calmd, counted with rf-count. Set true for the legacy rf-count-genome + rf-rctools extract path.

star_multimap_nmax.description: Maximum number of loci a read is allowed to map to in STAR (`--outFilterMultimapNmax`). Reads mapping to more loci than this are discarded. Increase when studying repetitive non-coding RNAs.

bowtie_k.description: Report up to this number of alignments per read (`-k`).

bowtie_trim5.description: Trim this many bases from 5' read end (`--trim5`).

bowtie_trim3.description: Trim this many bases from 3' read end (`--trim3`).

bowtie_index.description: Optional path to a prebuilt Bowtie index (currently not consumed by workflow logic).

bowtie_n.description: Bowtie v1 `-n` seed mismatch mode value.

bowtie_max.description: Bowtie v1 `-m` maximum reportable alignments per read before suppression.

bowtie2_preset.description: Bowtie2 alignment preset. Default is equivalent to `--local -N 0 -D 20 -R 3 -L 20 -i S,1,0.50`.

skip_markdup.description: Skip SAMtools markdup deduplication (default: true). Position-based duplicate removal is not valid for chemical-probing libraries without UMIs, where reads sharing a 5' start are independent RT events rather than PCR duplicates. Leave enabled; UMI libraries are still deduplicated via UMI-tools. Set false only if you have a specific reason.

star_map_sjdb_overhang.description: STAR `--sjdbOverhang` for MaP alignment. Ideally `readLength - 1`; default 200 suits 201 bp reads.

rfcount_img.description: Deprecated: rf-count plot generation (`-g`) is always enabled.

rfcount_strandedness.description: Library strandedness fallback for rf-count-genome when RSeQC inference is unavailable (e.g. viral/bacterial references without a usable BED annotation).

rfcount_genome_map_quality.description: Minimum MAPQ score for rf-count-genome (`--map-quality`). Useful for filtering multi-mappers; 0 keeps all alignments.

rfcount_genome_block_size.description: Block size for per-chromosome memory allocation in rf-count-genome (`-bs`); increase for large genomes.

rfcount_genome_samtools_threads.description: SAMtools working threads per processor instance in rf-count-genome (`-wt`); total threads = `-p` × `-wt`.

rfcount_map_median_quality.description: MaP only: discard reads with median Phred+33 base quality below this value (`-eq`).

rfcount_map_no_deletions.description: MaP only: ignore all deletion events during mutation counting (`-nd`).

rfcount_map_no_ambiguous.description: MaP only: ignore ambiguously aligned deletion events (`-na`). Auto: off for M-MLV, on for Group II Intron (e.g. TGIRT); leave unset to use the auto default.

rfcount_map_no_insertions.description: MaP only: ignore insertion events during mutation counting (`-ni`). Auto: off for M-MLV, on for Group II Intron (e.g. TGIRT); leave unset to use the auto default.

rfcount_map_right_deletion.description: MaP only: mark only the right-most base of a deletion as mutated (`--right-deletion`). Auto: on for M-MLV, off for Group II Intron (e.g. TGIRT); leave unset to use the auto default.

rfcount_map_discard_consecutive.description: MaP only: discard mutations within N nt of each other (`-dc N`). Auto: 3 when `RT_enzyme` is a Group II Intron RT (e.g. TGIRT), off for M-MLV; leave unset to use the auto default.

rfcount_map_eval_surrounding.description: MaP only: also evaluate quality of ±1 nt surrounding each mutation (`-es`).

rfcount_trim_5prime.description: Trim this many bases from the 5' read end for rf-count (`-t5`).

rfcount_primary_only.description: Use only primary alignments in rf-count (`--primary-only`).

rfcount_discard_clipped_reads.description: Discard reads with excessive 5' or 3' end clipping in rf-count / rf-count-genome (`--discard-clipped-reads`).

rfcount_paired_only.description: For paired-end samples, use only reads with both mates mapped (`--paired-only`).

rfcount_properly_paired.description: For paired-end samples, use only properly paired reads (`--properly-paired`).

rfcount_map_sort_by_read_name.description: In mutation mode (`-m`), pre-sort paired-end reads by read name (`--sort-by-read-name`). No effect on single-end data.

rfcount_map_discard_shorter.description: In mutation mode (`-m`), discard reads shorter than this value (`--discard-shorter`).

rfcount_map_min_quality.description: In mutation mode (`-m`), minimum Phred+33 base quality for mutations (`--min-quality`).

rfcount_map_collapse_consecutive.description: In mutation mode (`-m`), collapse consecutive mutations/indels (`--collapse-consecutive`). Auto: on unless `RT_enzyme` is a Group II Intron RT (e.g. TGIRT); leave unset to use the auto default.

rfcount_map_max_collapse_distance.description: In mutation mode with collapsing enabled, max distance to collapse (`--max-collapse-distance`).

rfnorm_remap_reactivities.description: Remap normalized reactivities to the 0-1 range according to Zarringhalam et al. (`--remap-reactivities`).

rfnorm_reactive_bases.description: Reactive bases used for normalization window selection (`--reactive-bases`), e.g. `AC` for DMS.

rfnorm_norm_window.description: Normalization window size (`--norm-window`). Auto: 50 for DMS or RT-stop, unset otherwise; leave unset to use the auto default.

rfnorm_dynamic_window.description: Enable dynamic normalization window (`--dynamic-window`). Set to a positive integer to enable (value is passed to `--norm-window`); set to `false` or `0` to explicitly disable even for DMS (which enables it by default). Leave unset to use the per-method default.

rfnorm_use_normfactor.description: Cross-experiment normalization via rf-normfactor (one factor set per reference, fed to rf-norm via `-nf`), putting reactivities on a common scale. Leave unset for auto (enabled only for a reference with more than one treated sample to cross-normalise); set `true` to force on, `false` to force off (per-sample box-plot).

rfnorm_normfactor_min_coverage.description: rf-normfactor minimum coverage (`-mc`): bases below this coverage are excluded from the normalization factor calculation. Auto: 1000 for MaP, 50 for RT-stop; leave unset to use the auto default.

rfnorm_norm_method.description: Override rf-norm normalization method (`-nm`). 2=90% Winsorizing, 3=Box-plot, 4=Mitchell (MaP only).

rfnorm_raw.description: Score raw reactivities without applying normalization (`--raw`).

rfnorm_ignore_lower_than_untreated.description: Set reactivities lower than untreated to zero for Ding or Siegfried scoring (`--ignore-lower-than-untreated`).

rfnorm_mean_coverage.description: Discard transcripts with mean coverage below this threshold (`--mean-coverage`).

rfnorm_median_coverage.description: Discard transcripts with median coverage below this threshold (`--median-coverage`).

rfnorm_nan.description: Positions with read coverage below this threshold are reported as NaN (`--nan`). Auto: 1000 for MaP, 50 for RT-stop. Set to 0 to disable NaN masking.

rfnorm_prefilter_min_coverage.description: Genome route only: after rf-rctools extract, keep transcripts with at least one position at this coverage or higher before rf-norm. Set to 0 to keep the full annotation RC.

rfnorm_img.description: Deprecated: rf-norm plot generation (`--img`) is always enabled.

rffold_img.description: Generate ViennaRNA RNAplot structure diagrams via rf-fold (`-g`). Disabled by default; slow on large transcriptomes. Use `--r2dt` for template-based diagrams instead.

jackknife_reference.description: Path to a reference `.db` structure file for rf-jackknife normalisation assessment. When provided, rf-jackknife runs between rf-norm and rf-fold and the output CSV reports optimal slope/intercept values. When omitted, rf-fold runs directly using whatever slope/intercept params are set.

rfjackknife_slope.description: Comma-separated slope range to search in rf-jackknife (`-sl`), e.g. `0,5`.

rfjackknife_intercept.description: Comma-separated intercept range to search in rf-jackknife (`-in`), e.g. `-3,0`.

rfjackknife_slope_step.description: Step size for slope grid search in rf-jackknife (`-ss`).

rfjackknife_intercept_step.description: Step size for intercept grid search in rf-jackknife (`-is`).

rfjackknife_mfmi.description: Use modified FMI (Lan et al. 2022) instead of standard FMI in rf-jackknife (`-m`).

rfjackknife_relaxed.description: Use relaxed FMI criteria (Deigan et al. 2009) in rf-jackknife (`-x`).

rfjackknife_keep_lonelypairs.description: Retain lonely base-pairs (1 bp helices) in the reference structure before comparison (`-kl`).

rfjackknife_keep_pseudoknots.description: Retain pseudoknotted base-pairs in the reference structure during FMI comparison (`-kp`). Disabled by default because rf-fold cannot predict pseudoknots, so including them systematically lowers FMI.

rfjackknife_only_common.description: Only use transcripts present across all replicates in rf-jackknife (`-oc`).

rfjackknife_img.description: Generate R heatmap of grid-search results in rf-jackknife (`-g`).

rfjackknife_rf_fold_params.description: Additional rf-fold parameters passed inside rf-jackknife (`-rp`), e.g. `-md 500`.

rfjackknife_pool_all.description: Pool XMLs from all sample groups into a single rf-jackknife run (output: `jackknife/all_groups/`) instead of running one jackknife per group. Default: true.

stop_after_jackknife.description: Stop the pipeline after rf-jackknife completes, skipping rf-fold, structure visualisation, browser track generation, and RDAT output. Useful for calibration runs where you only want jackknife statistics.

rfrctools_gtf_feature.description: GTF feature type to extract with rf-rctools (`-f`); override for non-standard annotations.

rfrctools_gtf_attribute.description: GTF attribute used as the output RC entry ID by rf-rctools (`-b`).

rfeval_reference.description: Path to a `.db` file of known RNA secondary structures. Enables rf-eval when provided.

rfeval_windows.description: Optional manifest of sub-region references, one per line: `ref_seq_id start end structure_id [strand]` (1-based inclusive, in the XML's own coordinate space). When set, rf-norm reactivities are sliced to each window before rf-eval, so a sub-region structure (e.g. an Rfam element on a whole chromosome) is scored against a matching windowed XML instead of the diluted full transcript. `structure_id` must match an entry in `--rfeval_reference`.

rfeval_reactivity_cutoff.description: Cutoff for classifying a base as highly-reactive in rf-eval unpaired-coefficient calculation (`-c`).

rfeval_ignore_terminal.description: Exclude terminal base-pairs from rf-eval calculations (`-it`).

rfeval_terminal_as_unpaired.description: Treat terminal base-pairs as unpaired in rf-eval (`-tu`).

rfeval_img.description: Generate R metric plots in rf-eval (`-g`).

structextract.description: Run rf-structextract after rf-fold to extract high-confidence, low-reactivity / low-Shannon structural motifs from the folded structures.

structextract_win_size.description: rf-structextract window size in nt for median reactivity/Shannon calculations (`-w`).

structextract_min_transcript_len.description: rf-structextract skips low-reactivity/low-Shannon evaluation for transcripts below this length (`-ml`).

structextract_min_value_frac.description: rf-structextract windows with less than this fraction of bases covered are set to NaN (`-mv`).

structextract_min_below_median.description: rf-structextract minimum fraction of bases whose Shannon and reactivity are below the transcript median (`-mb`).

structextract_min_paired_frac.description: rf-structextract discards elements with less than this fraction of paired bases (`-mp`).

structextract_min_motif_len.description: rf-structextract discards structure elements shorter than this (`-mm`).

structextract_max_motif_len.description: rf-structextract discards structure elements longer than this (`-xm`). Unset for no limit.

structextract_max_loop_size.description: rf-structextract discards elements with a loop larger than this (`-xl`). Unset for no limit.

structextract_ignore_react.description: rf-structextract skips low-reactivity evaluation (`-ir`). When false (default), reactivity is evaluated so only regions with probing support are extracted.

structextract_ignore_shannon.description: rf-structextract skips low-Shannon evaluation (`-is`). When `false`, the Shannon-entropy test is applied so only high-confidence regions are extracted.

structextract_multiway_only.description: rf-structextract only reports elements encompassing multiway junctions (`-mo`).

structextract_one_per_file.description: rf-structextract reports each extracted element in a separate file (`-opf`).

structextract_eval_energy.description: rf-structextract only reports elements with a free energy significantly lower than expected by chance (`-ee`).

structextract_pvalue.description: rf-structextract p-value threshold for energy significance (`-v`); requires `--structextract_eval_energy`.

structextract_n_shufflings.description: rf-structextract number of sequence shufflings for energy evaluation (`-ns`).

structextract_dinucl_shuffle.description: rf-structextract preserves dinucleotide frequencies when shuffling for energy evaluation (`-ds`).

structextract_plot.description: Render an SVG diagram per extracted rf-structextract motif via ViennaRNA RNAplot.

correlate_replicates.description: Run rf-correlate to compute pairwise reactivity-profile correlations between replicates of each sample group (a replicate-reproducibility QC surfaced in MultiQC). Only runs for sample groups with more than one replicate; a no-op otherwise.

rfcorrelate_cap_react.description: Cap reactivities to this value before Pearson correlation in rf-correlate (`--cap-react`). Not applied to the Spearman run, which is rank-based.

correlate_min_values.description: rf-correlate minimum number of values to calculate a correlation (`-m`); a value between 0 and 1 is interpreted as a fraction of transcript length. Unset uses the tool default (off).

correlate_ignore_sequence.description: rf-correlate ignores sequence differences (e.g. SNVs) between compared transcripts (`-I`).

correlate_img.description: Generate the rf-correlate correlation heatmap PDF (`-g`; requires R).

rffold_ct.description: Write CT format structures with rf-fold (`-ct`). Disabled by default to keep dot-bracket output.

rffold_window.description: Enable windowed MFE folding in rf-fold with this window size (`-w -fw N`). Set null/unset to fold the whole transcript instead.

rffold_partition_window.description: Partition-function window size in rf-fold (`-pw N`).

rffold_unconstrained.description: Fold without reactivity constraints in rf-fold (`-u`).

rffold_vienna_no_lonely_pairs.description: Pass ViennaRNA no-lonely-pairs mode to rf-fold (`-vnlp`).

rffold_vienna_constrained.description: Use ViennaRNA hard constraints with rf-fold (`-vc`).

rffold_vienna_max_bp_span.description: Maximal base-pair span for ViennaRNA in rf-fold (`-vmd`).

rffold_vienna_bp_span.description: Minimal base-pair span for ViennaRNA in rf-fold (`-vms`).

rffold_only_common.description: Only fold transcripts covered in at least this number of XML experiments (`-oc`).

rffold_fold_constraint_file.description: Constraint file for allowed base-pairing positions (`-fc`).

rffold_unpaired_constraint_file.description: Constraint file for required unpaired positions (`-uc`).

rffold_shannon_entropy.description: Compute and report Shannon entropy in rf-fold (`-sh`).

rffold_slope.description: Slope for reactivity-to-folding-constraint conversion in rf-fold (`-sl`). Auto by `chemical`: DMS 4.6, NAI 2.2, 2A3 1, other/unset 1.8. Overridden by jackknife calibration when available.

rffold_intercept.description: Intercept for reactivity-to-folding-constraint conversion in rf-fold (`-in`). Auto by `chemical`: DMS -2, NAI -0.8, 2A3 -0.4, other/unset -0.6. Overridden by jackknife calibration when available.

rffold_vienna_rnaplot.description: Path to ViennaRNA `RNAplot` binary for SVG structure plots in rf-fold (`-vrp`).

r2dt.description: Generate template-based 2D RNA structure diagrams using R2DT, coloured by normalised SHAPE/chemical-probing reactivity.

r2dt_templatable_biotypes.description: Comma-separated GTF biotypes sent to R2DT. R2DT only has templates for structured ncRNA classes; transcripts of other biotypes (mRNA, lncRNA, ...) are excluded so R2DT never force-fits them to the wrong template, and are drawn by ViennaRNA instead. Matched case-insensitively against transcript/gene biotype.

rfwiggle_report_zeroes.description: Report positions with zero reactivity in the WIG/BigWig output (`-z`). Enabled by default so genome browsers receive complete tracks without gaps.

rfwiggle_keep_bases.description: Restrict WIG output to specific bases using an IUPAC code or combination (e.g. `AC` for DMS probing) (`-kb`). Default: all bases (`N`).

rnaframework_r_path.description: Path to R executable used by rf-count, rf-norm, and rf-fold plotting.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

executor_options.title: Executor options
executor_options.description: Cluster/executor parameters consumed by the `slurm` profile.
executor_options.help_text: These parameters are read by the generic `slurm` profile to set the SLURM partition, account, and any additional sbatch flags. They have no effect when the `slurm` profile is not active. Use the EBI-specific `codon` profile if you want the EBI Codon defaults without supplying these.

slurm_queue.description: SLURM partition / queue name passed via `--partition`.
slurm_queue.help_text: Translates to `process.queue` inside the `slurm` profile. Leave unset to omit `--partition` and use the cluster default.

slurm_clusterOptions.description: Extra sbatch flags appended verbatim to `process.clusterOptions`.
slurm_clusterOptions.help_text: Use for site-specific sbatch arguments (e.g. `--qos=highmem --constraint=avx2`). Combined with `--slurm_account` when both are provided.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
